summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Medford, Oklahoma. It identifies Medford as a city that serves as the county seat of Grant County in the United States state of Oklahoma. It gives the city's population as of the 2010 census.
one_line: Medford is a city in Oklahoma that serves as the county seat of Grant County, with 996 residents in the 2010 census.
key_facts: Medford is a city in Oklahoma, United States.
Medford is the county seat of Grant County, Oklahoma.
As of the 2010 census, the city population of Medford, Oklahoma was 996.
